text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha! I bought 'em~~! Carrot rice 
crackers from Uma-an!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing. At No 
Reason's request, we waited in a long line 
at a famous rice cracker shop and got our 
hands on the popular senbei.
choice_data_list:
Waiting in line for two hours was totally 
worth it...!

Waiting in line for two hours was 
definitely worth it...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ours was the very last one, you see~ I was 
on pins and needles wondering when it'd 
sell out.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Now then, where might the service center 
be? I'd like to have this gift-wrapped...
choice_data_list: Are those rice crackers for someone?
Are those rice crackers for someone?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Ah... Ummm...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: ...Um, to Yaeno, that is.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No Reason-san, we promised, didn't we? 
That you wouldn't leave your storage chest 
lying open. The other day, you just tossed 
your tracksuit onto the bed...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Your sense of discipline is far too low! 
Why are you being so sloppy?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"What's the big deal, what's the big deal! 
I only forgot a teensy little bit, didn't 
I?!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
If you nag me that much, I'm gonna 
suffocate and choke to death!!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: “—Mmmmmm...! —Mmmmmm...!”

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: —Hmph!! —Hmph!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"And that is why. I only hope this will 
put her back in good spirits, though..."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Kh!? No Reason-san...!?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Wh-Wha!? Yaeno!? Why art thou here?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: No Reason-san, why are *you* here...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I... Hm? What is in that bag...? Could 
that be the limited-distribution "Red Bean 
Cola"?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Well, um...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I thought I might have come across too 
harshly this morning...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That wasn't reprimanding you at all; I was 
merely lashing out with my own 
frustrations...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...I am truly, terribly sorry!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Yaeno, you...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: —Pfft, hehehe...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nya-ha-ha-ha!! To think we were both 
pondering the exact same thing!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Huh, the same...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ah! The carrot crackers from "Uma-an"...!? 
Could it be that you also...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! I was in the wrong too! I am 
reflecting on my actions, as you can see!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"So, wilt thou forgive me...? We get along 
so well, and I wish to remain good 
roommates with thee henceforth."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
............ Please raise your head, No 
Reason.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Likewise! As your good roommate, I look 
forward to continuing to live with you!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Yaenooo...!! I'm truly indebted to ya!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ah! While you're at it, could you maybe 
cut me some slack on cleaning my room~?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That is another matter entirely.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha! Can we not just brute-force our 
way through with sheer momentum?!
choice_data_list: Glad you two were able to make up.
I'm glad you two were able to make up.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Truly auspicious! And on such a 
joyous occasion, I'd love to make some 
merry noise!
choice_data_list: Then let's all go eat together!
Then how about hanging out at the arcade?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, how wonderful! Time for a 
reconciliation feast, a feast, I say~~!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! What you're eating looks delicious 
too, Yaeno~~♪ ...*glance*

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Honestly. Just one bite, alright?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, No Reason and the others enjoyed a 
banquet of reconciliation.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I approve! In that case, let us 
venture forth in grand style!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't this prize cute? C'mon, look at it, 
coochie-coo~~♪"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Wha--!? Please stop!! Not such an adorable 
gesture............ Haaauuhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, No Reason and the others deepened 
their bonds.
